stages.name: Costs of economic growth
stages.title: Costs of economic growth
stages.sub: The two costs that can come with a growing economy: uneven gains and sacrificed consumption today.

steps.q: A country's income grows by 5%. Business owners' profits rise 15%, but factory workers' wages only rise 1%. Did everyone gain the same amount from growth?
steps.right: No, some gained far more than others
steps.wrong: Yes, growth always spreads out evenly
steps.hint: Compare the 15% rise with the 1% rise.

steps.right: Resources are switched away from making consumer goods now
steps.wrong: They appear without affecting anything else
